## 2. Core Technical Competencies

### Backend Engineering & Distributed Systems
- Node.js & Express.js: Expert in constructing modular, scalable REST APIs, microservice controller factories, middleware pipeline chains, and event loops.
- TypeScript: End-to-end strict type safety across full-stack applications with Zod schema validation.
- Go (Golang): Programmed high-speed statutory calculation subroutines (`salary-processor-go`) handling complex numerical calculations.
- Multi-Core Worker Clustering: Distributed Node.js background workers across multi-core CPU instances, achieving a 65% request throughput improvement under high load.
- Real-Time Communication: Engine design using Socket.IO for sub-100ms WebSocket state synchronization across concurrent clients.

### Linux VPS Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
- Linux VPS Administration: Production Ubuntu server provisioning, SSH key hardening, automated UFW firewall configuration, and system resource monitoring.
- Nginx Web Server: Reverse proxy virtual host configuration, load balancing, SSL/TLS certificate automated management (Let's Encrypt / Certbot), and static asset caching.
- Process Management: PM2 cluster mode administration, zero-downtime application reloads, memory leak monitoring, and automated system restart scripts.
- DNS & Domain Routing: Cloudflare integration, CNAME/A record management, SSL/TLS full encryption modes.

### Databases & Memory Caching
- MongoDB: Mongoose schema architecture, compound index design, transaction isolation, and multi-stage aggregation pipelines for analytics.
- Redis: In-memory key-value caching layer, rate-limiting store, session cache, and asynchronous job queuing with BullMQ.
- SQL Databases: PostgreSQL and MySQL table normalizations, foreign key constraints, and query plan optimizations.

### Zero-Trust Security & Identity
- WebAuthn / FIDO2: Implemented passwordless biometric authentication (Fingerprint / TouchID / FaceID / Security Keys).
- SSO Gateway: Built a centralized single sign-on handoff protocol utilizing authorization code exchange to mitigate session hijacking.
- Security Headers & CSRF: HttpOnly SameSite encrypted cookie tokens, JWT signature verifications, and sliding-window rate limiters.

## 3. Detailed Case Studies & Production Architectures

### Masters Expo Campaign Command Center (CMS) — FlumenX
- Overview: Real-time event marketing operations center engineered for FlumenX client campaign management.
- Stack: Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Socket.IO, Linux VPS, Nginx, PM2.
- Key Achievements: Integrated live Socket.IO push alerts for task deliverables, dynamic campaign KPI tracking, dynamic RBAC menu guards parsing JWT claims, and zero-downtime deployment on Linux VPS.

### SUSRUTHA Healthcare CMS & Inpatient Portal — FlumenX
- Overview: Enterprise research hospital management engine and patient web portal for a 40-bed healthcare facility.
- Stack: Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Next.js 14, React, Sharp, Zod, Linux VPS, Nginx.
- Key Achievements: Automated background image/video compression pipeline powered by Sharp, multi-branch OPD time-slot concurrency locks, and Panchakarma care package reservation workflows.

### High-Throughput Statutory Payroll Engine (Worksphere) — Luvid Technologies
- Overview: Multi-tenant statutory salary processor and shift scheduling pipeline.
- Scale: Processed monthly statutory payroll for 150,000+ active employees.
- Architecture: Integrated Go worker microservices (`salary-processor-go`) for complex calculations of PF, ESI, overtime, vouchers, and statutory tax deductions with zero calculation discrepancies.

### Centralized Zero-Trust SSO & Identity Gateway — Luvid Technologies
- Overview: Centralized single sign-on authentication gateway and identity provider.
- Architecture: Secure cross-domain token hand-off protocol, FIDO2 WebAuthn passkey authentication, and sliding-window rate limiting.

### Multi-Tenant ERP, CRM, ATS, FinTech & Inventory Platforms
- Multi-Tenant ERP: Core operational accounting, procurement ledgers, and vendor invoicing with a 40% reduction in code duplication.
- Omnichannel CRM: Lead scoring automation, sales pipeline tracking, and Socket.IO team push notifications.
- FinTech Microfinance Engine: Automated micro-loan credit scoring, interest processing, and EMI repayment schedule generator.
- Recruitment ATS: Candidate sourcing, resume metadata extraction, and Kanban interview pipelines.
- Inventory & Stock Control: SKU barcode scanning, inter-warehouse stock transfer tracking, and batch expiry alert triggers via Redis.
